timing_boundaries: Never sum parent batch/merge/invocation/external spans with their children.

Pipeline CSV input_bytes/final_events describe run scope, not per-fragment bytes or a failed attempt result.
Task2 cache: first successful case 6 cached + 1 new; later cases 7 cached. Earlier failed attempt downloaded 5 + reused 1.

Task3 external finished_at was not originally recorded; left empty, not reconstructed from a rounded clock.
Task3 post-run comparisons were not separately timed; no retrospective zero or guessed wall time.
Cold download end-to-end performance is not measured by warm functional timings.
